stories.summary: "Overall, the ball is swinging a little less these days, whether in the IPL, domestic cricket or any other game. I suddenly found out that the ball has a lot of weight. About a month back, one day I just happened to check the weight of 15 new (Kookaburra) balls.

stories.title: IND vs NZ 2nd Test Weather Report: Will Rain Interrupt Play In Christchurch? Check Day-Wise Forecast
stories.summary: India will take on New Zealand in the second Test at Hagley Oval in Christchurch from November 27 to December 1, 2026. While both teams will look to put up a strong performance, weather conditions could have a role in deciding how much cricket is played during the five-day contest.

stories.title: Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy: Azharuddeen’s century powers Kerala into the Super League
stories.summary: Mohammed Azharuddeen’s signature rocking-the-bat celebration has become a defining moment in this season’s Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy T20 cricket tournament. The opening batter brought it out once again on Friday for his second T20 hundred (101, 57b, 8x4, 6x6) which dismantled Himachal Pradesh and helped Kerala register a 67-run win to qualify for the Super League.

stories.title: If Mohammed Siraj is world-class, why is he out?
stories.summary: “For me, he is bowling well. He is a world-class bowler. “The conversation I had with him was: ‘Listen, let’s strip it back a little bit. Where are we at the moment? “Selection is something we can’t really control. All we can control is putting our energy into the guys who are playing,” he said.

stories.title: Glenn makes 'free ball' history in WBBL after Dottin timed out
stories.summary: Watch the moment England's Sarah Glenn makes history in the women's Big Bash League as she bowls at an empty set of stumps with a 'free ball', to dismiss Deandra Dottin after the batter was ruled to have taken too long to face the delivery.

stories.title: Champions League: Man United and PSG held to draws, Bayern loses
stories.summary: Mauricio Pochettino was denied his first win as Manchester United coach in calamitous circumstances after a 2-2 draw with Sporting Lisbon in the Champions League. Paris Saint-Germain was held to the same scoreline by Roma, ending the back-to-back defending champion's 100% winning record and leaving Real Madrid out in front at the top of the standings.

stories.title: India v New Zealand Test: Shubman Gill’s character as captain on Test
stories.summary: Shubman Gill would be left with bitter recollections of having to close back-to-back Tests with part-timers Dhruv Jurel and Yashasvi Jaiswal. Even though momentarily it is all fun and games when batters are bowling dollies to bring a closure to a no-result Test, in effect, it means the bowlers have conceded their inability to force a victory.

stories.title: Former England scrum-half and commentator Starmer-Smith dies aged 81
stories.summary: Former England scrum-half and rugby union commentator Nigel Starmer-Smith has died aged 81. Starmer-Smith represented Harlequins and the Barbarians, and made seven appearances for England between 1969-71. After his retirement in 1976, Starmer-Smith moved into broadcasting and journalism. He voiced the BBC's highlights programme Rugby Special for 15 years and commentated for ITV at the 2003 World Cup in Australia, won by England.

stories.title: Knee surgery rules Sinner out of Australian Open
stories.summary: Jannik Sinner has been ruled out of the Australian Open in January following an operation on his knee. The 25-year-old Italian, who won the 2024 and 2025 titles at Melbourne Park, has not played competitively since winning Wimbledon on 12 July.

stories.title: Indian-origin footballer Krissh Mahatma, 18, shot dead outside US restaurant
stories.summary: Krissh Mahatma had moved from London to the United States to pursue a football career and was only three months into his first season with the Co-Lin Wolves when his life was cut short. The 18-year-old striker was shot dead outside a taco restaurant in Jackson, Mississippi, after an argument involving a group of people reportedly escalated into gunfire.

stories.title: Sooryavanshi storm cut short as Sri Lanka knock India out of Rising Stars Asia Cup
stories.summary: India A's Rising Stars Asia Cup campaign came to a heartbreaking end after Sri Lanka A produced a stunning batting exhibition to storm into the final with an emphatic eight-wicket victory in the semi-final in Doha on Wednesday. 3 overs with eight wickets in hand. For India, the defeat also meant an underwhelming end to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's campaign.

stories.title: GB win decider to reach Davis Cup semis for first time since 2019
stories.summary: Great Britain advanced to the semi-finals of the Davis Cup for the first time since 2019 as Henry Patten and Neal Skupski won a decisive doubles tie against third seeds Germany in Bologna. Patten and Skupski, playing together for the first time since announcing their partnership for the 2027 season, proved too clinical for Kevin Krawietz and Tim Puetz.

stories.title: Germany's Freigang given 16-month ban over drugs test issues
stories.summary: BBC Sport women’s football news reporter Published 12 minutes ago Germany international Laura Freigang has been suspended from football for 16 months over issues with three drugs tests. The 28-year-old will miss the Women's World Cup next summer and is banned from all football activity until after 7 October 2027.

stories.title: Jaydev Unadkat scripts history with stunning No. 11 knock, smashes T20 world record
stories.summary: Jaydev Unadkat produced a remarkable batting effort from an unlikely position, becoming the highest-scoring No. 11 batter in men's T20 cricket history during Saurashtra's Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy (SMAT) clash against Tamil Nadu at the Holkar Stadium in Indore on Thursday. Unadkat struck three fours and two sixes and shared a sensational 62-run partnership for the 10th wicket with Chetan Sakariya.

stories.title: BIMSTEC meet: Roshan and Sabita win high hurdles gold
stories.summary: Shaik Roshan and Sabita Toppo clinched gold medals in men’s 110m and women’s 100m hurdles events respectively in the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC) under-23 international athletics meet at the Kalinga Stadium on Thursday. 63m. stories.title: SMAT: Rizvi’s unbeaten century gives UP a consolation win
stories.summary: Sameer Rizvi’s blistering 100* off 46 balls powered former champions Uttar Pradesh to a six-wicket victory over Mizoram at the Wankhede Stadium on Thursday, but the win could only serve as a consolation in a disappointing Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy (SMAT) campaign. UP finished fifth in Elite Group A with 16 points from seven matches, already out of Super League contention.

stories.title: Irish runner Beggs wins award for Boston fair play
stories.summary: Northern Ireland's Aaron Beggs is one of two runners who have been awarded the International Fair Play award after they stepped in to help a fellow competitor cross the finish line at the Boston Marathon. Beggs and Robson De Oliveira encountered Ajay Haridasse struggling to stand and put their arms around him to help him down the finishing straight.

stories.title: Sahiba Bali's Gurpurab post with Arjun Kapoor sparks dating buzz, fans wonder 'is it a soft launch?'
stories.summary: Dating lives of celebrities are something every entertainment junkie is deeply interested in. And, with the strong presence of social media, fans often get to know about the whereabouts of their favourite actors. Something similar happened recently when actor and sports presenter Sahiba Bali uploaded a photo with actor Arjun Kapoor.

stories.title: India's top court tightens food warning labels in ne
stories.summary: NEW DELHI, - India's top court ruled on Thursday that separate warning labels should appear on the front of food packaging for every nutrient of concern, tightening a government proposal that called for a single label and dealing a blow to the $100 billion industry that has long opposed the measure.

stories.title: Explained: What is ‘Starmind’? SpaceX gets FCC nod for 1 million space-based data centres - Full details
stories.summary: SpaceX has received approval from the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to deploy up to 1 million orbital computing modules for a proposed constellation of space-based data centres, marking a major push to take artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure beyond Earth.

stories.title: Explainer-Spain’s snap election — why it matters and who might win?
stories.summary: MADRID, Nov 26 (Reuters) – Spain goes to the polls on Sunday in an early parliamentary election that may usher in a right-wing coalition to replace the Socialist-led minority government of Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez, one of Europe’s last leftist leaders. Sanchez called the election after parliament on October 2 rejected his decrees to address growing anger over rising rents and evictions.

stories.title: Who Is Vardhaman Jain? Chennai Businessman Offers 121 Kg Gold Ornaments Worth ₹206 Cr To Lord Venkateswara
stories.summary: Chennai-based industrialist and philanthropist Vardhaman Jain has made a significant religious contribution by donating 121 kg of gold ornaments valued at ₹160 crore to the Tirumala Temple in Andhra Pradesh. Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu visited the temple on Thursday, Nov 26, to attend the formal handover ceremony.

stories.title: Knowledge Nugget | EPFO’s new rules explained: From easier PF withdrawals to payout plan for retirees
stories.summary: The Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), at the meeting of its Central Board of Trustees (CBT) on November 19, 2026, approved key changes to Provident Fund (PF) withdrawal rules. These include reducing the waiting period for final PF settlement after unemployment from 12 months to two months, lowering the minimum balance that members must retain in their accounts from 25% to 10%, and introducing a Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP).

stories.title: In a nation of chai drinkers, Darjeeling’s prized tea is a sliver of the crop. Its history and troubles | HT Explainers
stories.summary: Union commerce and industry minister Piyush Goyal said last week the government was working to restore the glory of Darjeeling tea – the first Indian product to win a geographical indication (GI) tag – at a time when the hills are growing less tea than they did a generation ago and the industry is struggling.

stories.title: Is India Inc to blame for low wages and unemployment?
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has questioned whether Indian companies are doing enough to create jobs, raise wages and seize available opportunities. Despite years of government incentives, corporate tax cuts and policies such as Make in India, economic growth has not translated into better-paying jobs and greater employment. Is India Inc to blame for low wages and unemployment?

stories.title: What are tariffs, how do they work and why is Trump using them?
stories.summary: He argues these import taxes boost US manufacturing and create jobs. But critics say they have put up prices for American consumers and disrupted and damaged the global economy. For example, a 10% tariff on a $10 product would mean a $1 tax on top - taking the total cost to $11.

stories.title: Is a proof enough if it isn't beautiful?
stories.summary: On 20 November, Levent Alpöge, a mathematician at Anthropic, posted a short note on his personal website. “I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis,” he wrote. For the uninitiated, the Riemann Hypothesis is a 167-year-old conjecture about the distribution of prime numbers.

stories.title: Maharashtra's new property card plan: What flat owners, homebuyers need to know
stories.summary: The Maharashtra government has proposed issuing separate property cards for individual flats in buildings, recording ownership details, sanctioned area, associated rights, mortgages and other liabilities. The proposed system, called the Vertical Property Card, aims to create an independent supplementary record of rights for every eligible flat or unit, alongside existing land records.

stories.title: Can charity money be used to fight Tata Sons listing? Vijay Singh seeks urgent probe
stories.summary: VETO Sayantani Biswas Published 26 Nov 2026, 10:04 PM IST Prefer Livemint on Google A fresh rift within the Tata Trusts has brought the group's charitable finances into focus, with trustee Vijay Singh questioning whether funds meant for public welfare could be used to finance a legal battle that may delay Tata Sons' stock market listing.

stories.title: What is EPFO Amnesty Scheme 2026? Importance and significance for legacy PF trusts
stories.summary: Over the years, several establishments formed independent PF trust to administer benefits for their employees. In many instances, these trusts obtained recognition under the Income-tax Act, 1961 and operated as employer-managed. However, recognition under Income tax law and exemption under PF law are two different statutory requirements.

stories.title: Is Offering Flowers To Babasaheb A Crime?: Saurav Das Claims He Was Stopped At UP Border
stories.summary: Cockroach Janta Party founder Saurav Das on Thursday claimed that he was stopped at the border while travelling to Meerut in Uttar Pradesh to pay tribute to Dr BR Ambedkar on Constitution Day. Taking to X, Das alleged that he was not allowed to proceed to the location where Ambedkar's statue was installed.

stories.title: Do warning labels on junk food work? Evidence from Israel, Chile and Mexico | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The Supreme Court on Thursday directed the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) to bring in red warning labels on packaged food high in sugar, fat or salt in a single phase, and to revisit the nutrient limits it had proposed. The regulator has four months to finalise the draft regulations.

stories.title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra Privacy Display explained: What is it and how it works
stories.summary: Samsung’s Privacy Display is a feature built into the Galaxy S26 Ultra that makes the screen harder to read from the side. With the feature enabled, the display directs more light forward, so text and images are easier to see when you look straight at the phone. How Samsung’s Privacy Display worksSamsung calls the technology behind it Flex Magic Pixel.

stories.title: KPSC recruitment scam in Karnataka: How question papers and answer keys reached candidates ahead of exams | Explained
stories.summary: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has alleged that senior Karnataka Public Service Commission (KPSC) officials, including its then Chairman Shivashankarappa Sahukar and Controller of Examinations Gyanendra Kumar Gangwar, were involved in leaking question papers and answer keys for the recruitment of 400 veterinary officers. stories.title: From refined sugar to jaggery: What you need to know before switching your everyday sweetener
stories.summary: Jaggery is often considered healthier than white sugar, but here are the nutritional differences that may surprise you. Swapping sugar with jaggery feels virtuous.
